title: Max Bareiss on GOFR — Galaxy Onchain Financing Rate
summary: Galaxy is a digital asset and blockchain leader helping institutions, startups, and individuals shape a changing economy.
body_markdown:
What if you could access DeFi's capital efficiency without managing wallets, smart contracts, or onchain operations?


In this conversation, Max Bareiss, Head of Lending at Galaxy, explains how the[Galaxy Onchain Financing Rate (GOFR)](https://www.galaxy.com/global-markets/lending/galaxy-onchain-financing-rate) gives institutional borrowers exposure to optimized onchain financing.


If you'd like to discuss what this looks like for your specific situation,[contact](https://www.galaxy.com/global-markets/lending/galaxy-onchain-financing-rate?utm_campaign=42223018-GOFR%20%E2%80%94%20Galaxy%20Onchain%20Financing%20Rate&utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-8p75yd7kMX2yuSsaUHbicj19x3d3s8r4AjK-__OF2_toE2cMOzw2uDFgRt3K6aL1h0tpwH#contact-our-desk) Galaxy's Lending Desk.
